about.desc: ArcBlog is a Blocklet blog: DID Wallet identity is the author credential, posts are Markdown-first, and images live in the Arc file space.
about.lifecycle-desc: Posts follow a draft → published → archived lifecycle with optimistic concurrency and a full audit trail. Soft deletes keep records recoverable.
about.title: About ArcBlog
access.admin-only: Sign in as an administrator to see this list.
access.desc: Reading rights created when a paid order settles.
access.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view the economy and grants.
access.grants-empty: Created automatically when a paid reading order settles.
access.title: Access grants
agents.admin-only: Sign in as an administrator to see this list.
agents.agent-closed: Default-closed (spec §130): settle_payment, change_wallet, change_role never run from the agent surface.
agents.agent-grants-empty: How to grant one: node scripts/arcblog-agent.mjs authorize --agent <did> --capability agent.write --ttl 30
agents.desc: Time-boxed capability grants issued to agents.
agents.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node health, Hubs, economy and agent state.
agents.mutations: This console reports state only. Value-bearing mutations (settlement, wallets, roles, payments) stay deliberate CLI actions with a DID session.
agents.title: Agent grants
appearance.desc: Theme, tone and palette for this site. Admins set the defaults; signed-in users can personalize their own theme.
appearance.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to set this site's palette and tone. Signed-in users can also personalize their own theme.
appearance.title: Appearance
categories.cat-remove-msg: Existing posts keep their category text, but the publish validator will reject it afterwards.
categories.cat-slug-hint: Lowercase letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. technology.
categories.desc: Taxonomy used by the publish validator and the public feed.
categories.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to manage the site.
categories.title: Categories
compose-edit.cover-hint: Shown as the card cover in the story list and at the top of the article. Upload via the Images panel below, then paste the URL here.
compose-edit.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to unlock the editor. Drafts stay in the private drafts directory until published.
compose-edit.images-desc: Drop a cover or inline image here. Media is stored in the site file space; paste the resulting URL into Markdown: ![Alt text](URL).
compose-edit.publish-hint: Published. The draft copy is still in studio drafts — delete it there when done.
compose-edit.seo-desc: Optional: set seo title/description and OG title/description/image. Defaults fall back to post title, summary, and cover image.
compose-edit.slug-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; used in the URL /posts/<slug>.
compose-edit.title: Edit post
compose.checks-desc: Title and slug are required. Publishing is immediately public; drafts stay private until published. Saving an existing slug overwrites that record.
compose.cover-hint: Shown as the card cover in the story list and at the top of the article. Upload via the Images panel below, then paste the URL here.
compose.draft-saved: Draft saved — preview it from the studio.
compose.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to unlock the editor. Drafts stay in the private drafts directory until published.
compose.images-desc: Drop a cover or inline image here. Media is stored in the site file space; paste the resulting URL into Markdown: ![Alt text](URL).
compose.seo-desc: Optional: set seo title/description and OG title/description/image. Defaults fall back to post title, summary, and cover image.
compose.slug-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; used in the URL /posts/<slug>.
dashboard.agents-empty: No agent grants. Read-only tools are available by default; write tools need a grant.
dashboard.desc: Node identity, roles, taxonomy and recent activity for this ArcBlog instance.
dashboard.economy-empty: No orders yet. Products and tips appear here once readers pay.
dashboard.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node identity, roles, taxonomy and operations data.
dashboard.node-empty: No node profile yet. Run: node scripts/arcblog-node.mjs init
dashboard.title: Dashboard
feeds.desc: Subscription and index surfaces generated from published content.
feeds.feeds-agent: Agent access (llms.txt / MCP) is declared by the runtime.
feeds.feeds-desc: These surfaces are always on and generated from published content — nothing to configure.
feeds.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view the distribution surfaces.
feeds.title: Feeds
heroes.content-empty: Nothing here yet. Write your first post.
heroes.desc: Home carousel records: title, image URL, target link and sort order.
heroes.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to manage the site.
heroes.hero-admin-desc: Heroes render as the homepage carousel. Each record needs a title, an image URL, and a target link; sort orders the slides ascending.
heroes.hero-delete-msg: This removes the hero record permanently.
heroes.hero-dropzone-desc: Upload an image here, then paste the resulting URL into the form above.
heroes.hero-id-hint: Lowercase letters, numbers and dashes; same ID overwrites.
heroes.hero-quickadd-hint: Click a post row to stage it below, then confirm. Title, summary, cover and /posts/<slug> link are copied automatically.
heroes.title: Hero management
hub.approve-msg: The relation becomes indexed. Only meaningful for applied relations.
hub.cli-desc: Relation ids are derived from the Hub DID by hashing, which the UI cannot compute — add a Studio and rebuild the index with:
hub.desc: Studio ↔ Hub relations and the derived content index. Indexing is the Hub's sovereignty: it only ever carries metadata, never the source body.
hub.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to curate Studios and the content index.
hub.index-empty: Index is empty. Rebuild: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs hub index rebuild
hub.purge-msg: Deletes the tombstone entirely. Prefer Terminate for auditability.
hub.reject-msg: The relation becomes a removed tombstone (kept for audit). Either side may terminate.
hub.relations-empty: No relations yet. A Studio applies with: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs hub register --hub-did <did>
hub.relations-legend: applied = awaiting review · indexed = live · removed = terminated (Tombstone kept) · freshness fresh/stale/never/offline (derived by `hub refresh`; offline = last sync failed)
hub.title: Hub console
media.admin-only: Sign in as an administrator to see this list.
media.desc: The upload index and where each file is referenced.
media.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node health, Hubs, economy and agent state.
media.media-empty: How to add one: node scripts/arcblog-media.mjs add
media.title: Media
operations.desc: Live state of this node: health, discovery, Hubs, economy, media and agent grants.
operations.discovery-empty: How to publish it: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs discovery publish
operations.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node health, Hubs, economy and agent state.
operations.hubs-empty: How to add one: node scripts/arcblog-network.mjs hub register --hub-did <did>
operations.title: Operations
page-view.title: Page
pages-admin.created-ok: Page created offline. Bring it online when ready.
pages.act-delete-msg: Pages have no soft delete — this removes the record.
pages.act-offline-msg: Keeps an offline copy under page-drafts/; remove the public copy to complete.
pages.act-publish-msg: Writes a public copy under pages/; delete the offline copy afterwards.
pages.created-ok: Page created offline. Bring it online when ready.
pages.desc: Standalone pages such as About. Two states only — online and offline; no post lifecycle, no RSS, no Hub indexing.
pages.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to manage standalone pages.
pages.list-empty: No pages yet. Create your first page above.
pages.offline-hint: Offline pages are admin-only. Bring one online when it is ready.
pages.online-hint: Online pages are public at /pages/<slug>; they stay out of RSS and the Hub index.
pages.title: Pages
policy.desc: The split policy and the product catalogue.
policy.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view the economy and grants.
policy.policy-empty: How to set it: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs policy init
policy.products-empty: How to add one: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs product add --id <id> --creator-did <did> --price-amount <n>
policy.title: Split policy
posts.admin-archive-msg: This writes an archived copy to private drafts. The public post stays live until you remove it from public.
posts.admin-delete-msg: The record stays in drafts with status deleted and can be republished later.
posts.admin-publish-msg: This publishes the current draft record. Deleted records can be republished.
posts.admin-unpublish-msg: Archive first keeps a copy in drafts. Removing from public deletes the original from public posts.
posts.content-empty: Nothing here yet. Write your first post.
posts.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view node health, Hubs, economy and agent state.
posts.lifecycle-desc: Archive copies a post to the private drafts directory; Remove from public takes it off the public feed. Drafts can be published or soft-deleted from the row actions.
posts.studio-desc: Manage drafts, published stories, archived stories, and uploaded media from one wallet-bound workspace.
preview.notice: Draft preview — this record is not public.
preview.preview-delete-msg: The record stays in the archive with status deleted (soft delete).
preview.published-hint: Published. The draft copy is still in studio drafts — remove it when done.
preview.title: Preview
reader.paid-notice: This is a paid article. The full text is released after purchase — it is never shipped to your browser before that.
reader.title: Article
seo.desc: Site-level defaults: name, description, OG image and endpoint.
seo.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to manage site-level SEO.
seo.profile-empty: No node profile yet. Run: node scripts/arcblog-node.mjs init
seo.title: SEO
store.desc: Digital goods published by this node. The creator sets the price; buying happens with a DID wallet.
store.empty: No public products yet. Add one: node scripts/arcblog-economy.mjs product add --id <id> --creator-did <did> --price-amount <n>
store.howto-desc: A purchase is an Order paid through the configured adapter; settlement then splits the amount (creator / Hub / protocol), and a paid article unlocks through an Access Grant. This page is the catalogue only — there is no checkout here.
store.title: Creator store
factory.title: Node factory
factory.desc: The on-chain NFT factories that mint this node's identity, the node NFT they minted, and the operator commands for acquire / stake / revoke.
factory.gate-desc: Sign in with DID Wallet to view the chain factories and the node NFT.
factory.chain-empty: No factory yet. Create one: node scripts/arcblog-factory.mjs create --role studio --adapter ocap
factory.node-empty: No node NFT recorded yet. Mint one: node scripts/arcblog-node-nft.mjs acquire --role studio --adapter ocap
factory.node-state-acquired: acquired — the NFT exists, the role is not staked yet
factory.node-state-staked: staked — the NFT is locked in the stake
factory.actions-desc: The chain signs with the factory owner's key, which never reaches the browser: copy a command and run it on the node. Every step writes the result back into AFS, so this page shows the same truth as config/node-nft.json.
factory.admin-only: The factory registry lives in config/ (admin-only), so this card stays empty unless you are signed in as the blocklet owner.
